name: The bill
what: A receipt prints out of a slot into the wall beside or above your head: a dark printer drops in, the paper feeds down row by row while each row is typed onto it (title, a small line, dashed rules, the numbered lines, the total), its bottom edge torn; then it jolts and swings from the slot and settles. The Editor puts it behind the person, moves it with the camera and adds a soft shadow.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f8 the printer drops 34 px into place with a small settle (fading in over 4 f); from f7 the paper feeds down a row every 5 frames (closer with many lines: all rows within 56 f), each feed 4 f decelerating, and each row is typed onto it over 6 f as it comes out (the rules draw from the left); the printer's light blinks while it prints; after the total (f61 with the default 5 lines) the strip jolts 9 px down (3 f) and swings from the slot, 2.4 degrees damped over ~30 f, then sways 0.35 degrees while it holds; the last 10 f it all rises 30 px and fades (accelerating).
